claims.answer: Kepler supplies session_start for delegates/reviewers, session_read/session_send and a reports inbox within product-owned task/session context. Starting work in a more permissive mode or outside the agents owned task scope waits for user approval. session_send sends a prompt/message to another session or stops its turn. Out-of-scope sends require approval. inbox_read retrieves or waits for reports from sessions the caller started, and session_read exposes the other conversation.

sources.finding: Native tasks retain resources and sessions. The kepler-workspace tools let an agent create tasks/worktrees, start delegate/reviewer sessions, read their conversations, send messages and receive reports through its inbox. Actions outside its owned work and higher access modes require user approval.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler automations
sources.locator: Opening definition; Experimental gate; What it watches; Where it runs
sources.finding: Experimental Automations start an Action or custom prompt on schedules or matching GitHub/Jira activity. A GitKraken sign-in and an open Kepler install are required. Each run creates a task with its own worktree, and own-activity suppression avoids some repeat triggers.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler remote-environments
sources.locator: Two remote features; Local/SSH/WSL; Disconnect/server controls
sources.finding: Remote environments execute agents/worktrees/terminals on a user-owned SSH host or WSL instance. Remote Access instead reaches an existing Kepler installation. Disconnecting a window leaves remote server sessions running; a browser client cannot manage host connections.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler review-changes
sources.locator: Changes overlay; staging/commit; branch menu; comments
sources.finding: The Changes overlay displays changed code, with per-line review comments, staging and commit controls. Branch operations include rebase and merge-from-target; those are separate from remote PR merge authority.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler image-hero
sources.locator: Original pixels: Tasks in progress, Task96 Code Review & Pull Request Workflows, side-by-side Markdown/HTML code diff
sources.finding: The official original visibly displays removed/added figure, img alt and figcaption code lines beside the task list. This is evidence of an accessible code-diff interface, not an executed feature test.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler release-notes
sources.finding: The canonical release-note snapshot begins with0.24.0 dated2026-11-20 and says Kepler is public preview. A separately retrieved official query variant includes a newer0.25.0 entry; the two source snapshots are retained rather than silently refreshed.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler release-notes-alt
sources.finding: The official indexed query variant documents0.25.0 dated2026-11-25, including creating/editing/closing/reopening/merging GitHub.com pull requests and adding them to the merge queue. The canonical URL snapshot fetched earlier is missing this entry.

sources.title: GitKraken Kepler home
sources.locator: Download Kepler ADE Free; Start Free GitKraken Pro Trial; pricing section
sources.finding: The marketing page advertises a free Kepler download and a GitKraken Pro trial. This bounded pass did not resolve recurring free-plan/private-repository limits or extract a reliable current monthly Kepler price.
